---
title: "Group summary report"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# `params` is supplied by the app (see render_report() in app.R).
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
```

- **File:** `r params$file_name`
- **Variable:** `r params$value`, grouped by `r params$group`
- **Rows:** `r params$n_rows`, of which `r params$n_missing` have a missing `r params$value` (excluded from n, mean and sd)
- **Created:** `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`

## Summary statistics

```{r table}
knitr::kable(params$table, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Boxplot

```{r boxplot}
print(params$plot)
```
